title: Hausdorff-measure scaling under the blow-up map
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, r, R ∈ ℝ with r > 0, and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set. Let η := η_{x,r} be SimonGMT's blowUpMap x r, η(z) = r⁻¹(z − x), and let H^n := μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on Euclid P = ℝ^P). Then H^n(η(S) ∩ B̄_R(0)) = ((ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹)^n · H^n(S ∩ B̄_{r·R}(x)), where B̄ denotes closed balls and the product is taken in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (r R : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S ∩ closedBall 0 R) = (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹ ^ n * μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x (r * R))
